tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Holds ink, ink-muted, accent, copper, danger and success at 4.5:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, sheets on surface. Same text pairings as surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, helper text on surface and surface-raised. Never below 14px.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers only. Not for input borders.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input, button-outline and focus-adjacent borders on surface and surface-raised; at least 3:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary actions, links, focus ring. Text or fill on surface and surface-raised, 7:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on an accent fill. Never literal white or black.

tokens.name: copper
tokens.usage: Emphasis marks, highlights and numerals on surface and surface-raised; 4.5:1 or better. One use per screen.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions on surface and surface-raised. Always paired with the word or an icon.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmations on surface and surface-raised. Blue-teal so it is not told apart from danger by hue alone; always paired with a word or icon.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero headline, one per page, on surface.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default copy. Minimum size on mobile.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Overlines and field labels; set in uppercase in English, sentence case in French.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and label, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, form field gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gap between related blocks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section gap on mobile; page gutter on desktop.
